notes.title: Save 30% on Bathory - The Bloody Countess during 2 weeks
notes.content:
Grab Bathory - The Bloody Countess and save 30% during these Two Weeks Sale*! 

Taking a twist on different theories and speculations, this hidden object adventure game appears a stunning entanglement of legends and evidence, history and magic. Challenge your i-spy skills as you decipher secret messages and uncover ancient manuscripts.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/486170?

*Offer ends on September 27, at 10AM Pacific Time
